_meta.description: HCTC product-numbering reference DB. Format AABBCC-N: AA=class/block, BB=sub-department, CC=subcategory, -N=iteration/variant.
_meta.class_rule: Scheme (AABBCC-N) is for EXEMPT and NON-INVENTORY only. INVENTORY items use separate generic numbers, never the scheme. Class is decided per item at creation; AA maps to class for defined blocks (18=Exempt; 27/96/97/98/99=Non-inventory).
_meta.usage: To suggest a number: pick class/AA, match product to a base by category+description+examples, suggest base-(next_iteration). A base with legend_defined=true and item_count=0 is a valid empty bucket.

27.note: Special iteration syntax: connector pair + D/S + fiber count, e.g. 270001-1D1 (-1=OM4 vs OS2 default), 270025-12F (12-fiber pigtail).
